Return to Sender vol. 1 (USA)

2024
GPS trackers returned to Amazon, mapped routes, audio recordings, visual documentation
ZK/U, Berlin

Return to Sender follows Amazon returns into a logistics network that customers never see. Participants across the United States returned GPS trackers to Amazon, mapping each package’s route through warehouses, repair centers, and disposal sites, and were invited to enclose letters of care and solidarity addressed to the warehouse workers who would handle them. The routes, audio recordings, and documentation were shown at ZK/U in Berlin in “No Departures without Arrivals,” during Berlin Art Week 2024, alongside the Supply Chain Manifest, a tool that maps the journeys of returned packages. Against the costs to labor and the environment that the routes reveal, the project argues for regional unionization and for nationalizing logistics corporations like Amazon.
